palestine-2012.notes: The page is a series history on a staff site of Palestine Polytechnic University, not a website of the 2012 contest; it is the only source and gives no date for 2012. Roles changed from web to report.

sources.disagreement: The earlier reader found a page with only a title; our copy shows an Arabic history of the series that covers the 2012 first edition, so it is a report about the contest, not an empty page.
sources.evidence: Staff page headed 'PCPC Palestinian Collegiate Programming Contest' whose Arabic history says the first contest, in 2012, was held at Palestine Polytechnic University.
